Name: Blossom Cliff Farm
Author: Lavliette
Description:
[u][b]New Update[/b][/u]
After playing on this map for quite a while I made some additional changes. 
It now includes a path which runs through the farm to help you with sectioning off parts of your farm and there are a few little extra tweaks.
Like your Pet now having a little pethouse. 

There's also an optional download version which removes all the flowers and trees at the river,
so you have some additional space.

[u][b]Features[/b][/u]
• All grass is tillable 
• Lots and lots of flowers for aesthetics 
• Replaces the Forest Farm


[b][u]Requirements[/u][/b]
• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets
• Made for Stardew Valley 1.5.5


[u][b]Installation[/b]
[/u]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Blossom Cliff Farm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the Forest Farm 

Enjoy!
